detections.mission_name: Unusual Transaction Velocity in Multiple Countries
detections.sql:
SELECT u.full_name 
FROM users u 
JOIN transactions t ON u.user_id = t.user_id 
JOIN login_events le ON u.user_id = le.user_id 
WHERE u.risk_level IN ('MEDIUM', 'HIGH') 
AND u.date_of_birth >= date('now', '-60 days') 
AND t.created_at >= date('now', '-2 hours') 
AND le.country IN (SELECT country FROM login_events GROUP BY country HAVING COUNT(country) >= 3) 
AND u.user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM transactions GROUP BY user_id HAVING COUNT(user_id) > 20)
detections.recommendation: Try broadening your search criteria or checking if the data for this period is available.

detections.mission_name: Systemic Integration Issues in Payment Failures
detections.sql:
SELECT 
  le.country, 
  COUNT(DISTINCT u.user_id) as active_users, 
  COUNT(CASE WHEN t.status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 END) as failed_transactions, 
  ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN t.status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(t.user_id), 2) as failure_rate
FROM users u
JOIN login_events le ON u.user_id = le.user_id
JOIN transactions t ON u.user_id = t.user_id
WHERE UPPER(u.account_status) = 'ACTIVE' AND t.created_at >= date('now', '-30 days')
GROUP BY le.country
HAVING failure_rate > 0.1
ORDER BY failure_rate DESC;

SELECT 
  u.user_id, 
  u.full_name, 
  t.instrument, 
  AVG(t.amount_usd) as avg_txn_volume
FROM users u
JOIN transactions t ON u.user_id = t.user_id
WHERE t.created_at >= date('now', '-90 days')
GROUP BY u.user_id, t.instrument
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN t.instrument IN (SELECT t2.instrument FROM transactions t2 GROUP BY t2.instrument HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t2.user_id) >= 3 AND SUM(t2.amount_usd) > 0.2 * (SELECT SUM(t3.amount_usd) FROM transactions t3 WHERE t3.user_id = u.user_id AND t3.created_at >= date('now', '-90 days'))) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY u.user_id, avg_txn_volume DESC;
detections.recommendation: Try broadening your search criteria or checking if the data for this period is available.
detections.original_query: Analyze the payment failure rate (status='failed') grouped by region (extracted from country) and identify if specific regions experience significantly higher failure rates ( > 10%) within the last 30 days, and have a standard deviation of transaction volume by instrument for each user where multiple instruments (>= 3) represent >20% of their total transaction volume_usd in the last quarter.

detections.sql:
SELECT 
  t.instrument, 
  COUNT(CASE WHEN t.status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*) AS failure_rate, 
  STDDEV(t.amount_usd) AS std_dev
FROM 
  transactions t
JOIN 
  users u ON t.user_id = u.user_id
WHERE 
  t.created_at >= date('now', '-30 days') AND 
  UPPER(t.instrument) LIKE '%PAYMENT%' AND 
  u.risk_score > 70
GROUP BY 
  t.instrument
HAVING 
  COUNT(DISTINCT t.instrument) >= 3 AND 
  SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 'FAILED' THEN t.amount_usd ELSE 0 END) / SUM(t.amount_usd) > 0.05
